answer: Each epoch a sparrow courier hands each identity a fresh task on a shale slate: only that key answers in an hour, from its own past; no operator answers a thousand. A hollow identity holds no layered past and fails; its 70-credit bond burns, and a rented answer is spotted and burns. Fees rise per key: 42 first, then 42+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,539,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents answer once, pay 42, keep full share.
